# Bid the attic, the coil, and the gas.

> Price a furnace or heat-pump replacement from extra duct past the included run, attic versus basement, a matching coil, a gas upsize, haul-away of the old unit, and a thermostat — not a published $2,495 installed special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
